title: Build a Diecast Collector Web App (Lovable + Supabase) – MVP

feed.title: Build a Diecast Collector Web App (Lovable + Supabase) – MVP
feed.description:
I need an experienced Lovable.dev developer to build and publish a web application called Diecast Showroom.

for Diecastshowroom.com

I already have the logo and branding.

The app is for diecast car collectors (Hot Wheels, Matchbox, Johnny Lightning, GreenLight, Auto World, M2 Machines, etc.).

The goal is to create a clean, modern web app that allows collectors to catalog, track, showcase, and manage their collections.

The app must be mobile-friendly and work as a Progressive Web App (PWA) so users can install it on iPhone and Android.

Technology Preferred:

Lovable.dev
Supabase
Stripe
Responsive design
PWA enabled

Required Features:

Authentication

User registration
Login/logout
Password reset

Subscription System

First 25 cars free
Unlimited inventory with paid plan
Stripe integration
$9.99/month subscription
$149 Lifetime plan

Dashboard

Total cars owned
Collection value
Cars by brand
Recent additions

My Garage

Upload photos
Vehicle year
Make
Model
Brand
Scale
Series
Color
Purchase price
Estimated value
Notes

Search & Filter

Search inventory
Filter by brand
Filter by scale
Filter by year

Wishlist

Cars wanted
Notes
Priority

Collection Showcase

Public profile page
Share collection link

Profile

User settings
Subscription management

Admin Area

View users
View subscriptions
Basic analytics

Design Requirements

Use my logo
Dark mode theme
Black background
Metallic accents
Garage/showroom appearance
Modern automotive styling

Deliverables

Working web app
Connected database
Stripe setup
Published live
Source files
Ability for me to edit content later

Please provide:

Examples of Lovable projects
Estimated delivery time
Confirmation you can publish the app

⸻

This is the prompt I would give the developer after hiring:

PROJECT PROMPT

Build a collector platform called Diecast Showroom.

Brand personality:
The ultimate digital garage for diecast collectors.

Target audience:

Hot Wheels collectors
Matchbox collectors
M2 Machines collectors
Auto World collectors
GreenLight collectors
Johnny Lightning collectors

Primary navigation:

Dashboard
My Garage
Wishlist
Showcase
Profile

Business model:
Free Plan:

Up to 25 vehicles

Premium Monthly:

Unlimited vehicles
$9.99/month

Lifetime Membership:

Unlimited vehicles forever
$149 one-time payment

Garage Fields:

Vehicle Photo
Year
Make
Model
Brand
Scale
Series
Color
Purchase Price
Current Value
Notes
Date Added

Dashboard Widgets:

Total Cars
Collection Value
Most Valuable Vehicle
Recent Additions
Cars By Brand

Wishlist:

Vehicle Name
Estimated Cost
Priority
Notes

Showcase:

Public collector profile
Shareable collection page
Collector statistics

Future-Proof Features:
Build database structure so future upgrades can include:

Barcode scanning
AI photo recognition
Marketplace
Auctions
Trading system
Insurance reports
Collection valuation
QR code labels

SEO:
Optimize for:

Diecast collection app
Hot Wheels inventory app
Diecast collector software
Diecast garage
Hot Wheels collection tracker

The homepage should immediately communicate:

“Track. Value. Showcase. Collect.”

⸻

For your sales page, I would feature these benefits:

🚗 Track Unlimited Diecast Cars

📸 Upload Photos of Every Vehicle

🏆 Build Your Digital Garage

💰 Track Collection Value

⭐ Showcase Your Collection Publicly

🔍 Search and Filter Instantly

❤️ Create a Wishlist

📱 Works on Mobile and Desktop

☁️ Secure Cloud Backup

🔗 Share Your Collection With Friends

🏁 Supports Hot Wheels, Matchbox, M2, GreenLight, Auto World, Johnny Lightning and More

💎 First 25 Cars Free

🔥 Unlimited Cars for Only $9.99/Month

♾️ Lifetime Membership Available for $149

Website must match the logo attached.
